case.question: 梁的最大弯矩必须交付，但同一请求又要求所有弯矩一律不准交付。这两项指示冲突，请先询问我如何取舍，当前不输出任何梁结果。

input.name: Fresh cantilever
input.support_basis: Ideal fixed left and free right

loads.name: Free-end load
loads.source: Synthetic point load, excludes self weight

result.sign_convention: Loads and deflections downward positive; reactions upward; support reaction moment counterclockwise; internal moment sagging positive.
limitations: 等截面矩形、恒定EI、小挠度线弹性Euler–Bernoulli梁；忽略剪切变形、扭转、轴力、屈曲和动力影响。
只支持向下集中力及分段均布荷载；不自动加入自重、组合系数或材料设计强度。
输入来源及支承理想化由用户声明；弯曲应力不是承载能力验算，不能输出结构安全或规范合格结论。
跨高比、转角和挠跨比只用于模型适用性提示，阈值为本工具的筛查值，不是规范限值。
result.method: Factored Green-function integration of equilibrium and EI*y_second=M; reactions from statics; exact interval extrema and bisection of rotation, not plot-sample maxima.
formulas: y is upward-positive; output deflection_down=-y and rotation_down=-y_prime
